accepted.s: The foundation stone of Amaravati capital city was laid on which date at Uddandarayunipalem?
accepted.x: The foundation stone of Amaravati was laid on 22 October 2015 at Uddandarayunipalem in Thullur mandal.
accepted.tq: Use the date-place combination to distinguish the foundation event from later policy developments.
accepted.sec: Capital region - Amaravati capital city plan, APCRDA area  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Uddandarayunipalem, where the foundation stone of Amaravati was laid, is situated in:
o: Tenali mandal on the south bank of the Godavari
Thullur mandal on the south bank of the Krishna
Mangalagiri mandal on the north bank of the Krishna
Guntur mandal on the north bank of the Krishna
accepted.x: Uddandarayunipalem is in Thullur mandal on the south bank of the Krishna River.
accepted.tq: Test the exact location by separating the mandal, river bank and river distractors.
accepted.sec: Capital region - Amaravati capital city plan, APCRDA area  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Who prepared the master plan for Amaravati as a water-centric city?
accepted.x: The master plan for Amaravati was prepared by Surbana Jurong of Singapore.
accepted.tq: Apply the who-prepared-what trap by distinguishing the planning agency from funding and partner institutions.
accepted.sec: Capital region - Amaravati capital city plan, APCRDA area  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes Amaravati?
o: A brownfield city on the Godavari between Kakinada and Rajahmundry
A hill city on the Pennar between Kurnool and Kadapa
A coastal industrial city between Visakhapatnam and Kakinada
A greenfield city on the Krishna between Vijayawada and Guntur
accepted.x: Amaravati is planned as a greenfield city on the Krishna River between Vijayawada and Guntur, in Thullur mandal.
accepted.tq: Use the location-comparison method to separate the correct river, cities and city type.
accepted.sec: Capital region - Amaravati capital city plan, APCRDA area  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The master plan of Amaravati envisages a water-centric city with approximately what proportion of green and blue space?
accepted.x: The Amaravati master plan provides for 51% green and blue space and follows a 30-minute-city design.
accepted.tq: Separate the percentage figure from the related 30-minute-city design feature.
accepted.sec: Capital region - Amaravati capital city plan, APCRDA area  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The expression ‘30-minute-city design’ is associated with:
accepted.x: The 30-minute-city design is a feature of the Amaravati master plan prepared by Surbana Jurong.
accepted.tq: Identify the project by linking a planning concept with its city rather than with an authority or corridor.
accepted.sec: Capital region - Amaravati capital city plan, APCRDA area  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding land pooling in Amaravati:
1. About 93.1% of 37,921 acres was pooled in Phase-I.
2. 70,550 returnable plots were allotted.
3. Phase-II covers about 16,666 acres in seven villages.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Phase-I involved 93.1% of 37,921 acres and 70,550 returnable plots, while Phase-II covers about 16,666 acres in seven villages.
accepted.tq: Check each numerical statement independently before selecting the combined code.
accepted.sec: Capital region - Amaravati capital city plan, APCRDA area  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which sequence correctly represents the major stages in the recent capital-status developments of Amaravati?
o: Three-capitals plan — High Court upholds Amaravati — Amaravati relaunched — sole-capital legislation
High Court upholds Amaravati — three-capitals plan — sole-capital legislation — Amaravati relaunched
Amaravati relaunched — three-capitals plan — High Court upholds Amaravati — sole-capital legislation
Sole-capital legislation — three-capitals plan — Amaravati relaunched — High Court upholds Amaravati
accepted.x: The three-capitals plan was announced in 2020, the High Court upheld Amaravati in March 2022, Amaravati was relaunched in May 2025, and the sole-capital legislation was passed in 2026.
accepted.tq: Arrange the events using the first and last dates before resolving the middle sequence.
accepted.sec: Capital region - Amaravati capital city plan, APCRDA area  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Under the AP Reorganisation (Amendment) Act, 2026, Amaravati became the sole capital of Andhra Pradesh with effect from:
accepted.x: The 2026 amendment makes Amaravati the sole capital with effect from 2 June 2024.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the retrospective effective date from the dates of foundation and relaunch.
accepted.sec: Capital region - Amaravati capital city plan, APCRDA area  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The three-capitals plan of 2020 proposed which of the following combinations?
o: Legislative Amaravati, executive Visakhapatnam and judicial Kurnool
Legislative Kurnool, executive Amaravati and judicial Visakhapatnam
Legislative Visakhapatnam, executive Kurnool and judicial Amaravati
Legislative Amaravati, executive Kurnool and judicial Vijayawada
accepted.x: The 2020 proposal designated Amaravati as the legislative capital, Visakhapatnam as the executive capital and Kurnool as the judicial capital.
accepted.tq: Match each capital function with its proposed city, watching for swapped authorities and places.
accepted.sec: Capital region - Amaravati capital city plan, APCRDA area  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched with the funding or work figures associated with Amaravati?
accepted.x: The sanctioned works numbered 96 and were worth ₹57,592.71 crore. The other three funding figures are correctly matched.
accepted.tq: Find the reversed number-and-value pair in the long numerical options.
accepted.sec: Capital region - Amaravati capital city plan, APCRDA area  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The APCRDA was established under which legislation?
o: AP Capital Region Development Authority Act, 2014
accepted.x: The Andhra Pradesh Capital Region Development Authority was set up under the AP CRDA Act, 2014.
accepted.tq: Use the institution-law association and reject legislation connected only with reorganisation or land pooling.
accepted.sec: Capital region - Amaravati capital city plan, APCRDA area  [APPSC]

accepted.s: According to the current configuration stated for the APCRDA, which combination is correct?
o: 8,452 sq km covering Guntur, Palnadu and Bapatla districts
7,068.20 sq km covering Visakhapatnam, Vizianagaram and Srikakulam
8,352.69 sq km covering Krishna, Guntur and Kurnool districts
375 sq km covering only the Amaravati capital city
accepted.x: The current APCRDA configuration covers 8,452 sq km across Guntur, Palnadu and Bapatla districts. The 375 sq km figure refers to the capital city area, not the entire region.
accepted.tq: Separate the regional area from the capital-city area and distinguish current and older area figures.
accepted.sec: Capital region - Amaravati capital city plan, APCRDA area  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The older notified area figures associated with the APCRDA were:
o: 7,068.20 sq km initially and 8,352.69 sq km after expansion
8,352.69 sq km initially and 7,068.20 sq km after expansion
8,452 sq km initially and 375 sq km after expansion
375 sq km initially and 8,452 sq km after expansion
accepted.x: The APCRDA region was expanded from 7,068.20 sq km to 8,352.69 sq km in the older area figures. The capital city area is separately stated as 375 sq km.
accepted.tq: Read the direction of change carefully instead of confusing regional and city-area figures.
accepted.sec: Capital region - Amaravati capital city plan, APCRDA area  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements about Amaravati is correct?
1. It was relaunched under the name ‘Restart Amaravati’ on 2 May 2025.
2. A UN-Habitat MoU is intended to establish a Centre of Excellence for Urban Affairs at Amaravati.
3. The Land Pooling Scheme 2.0 has commenced.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: the relaunch occurred on 2 May 2025, Land Pooling Scheme 2.0 commenced, and the UN-Habitat partnership concerns a Centre of Excellence for Urban Affairs.
accepted.tq: Treat each current-affairs statement as a separate claim and select the complete combination when all are supported.
accepted.sec: Capital region - Amaravati capital city plan, APCRDA area  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the code given below the lists.
List-I (Authority)
a. VMRDA
b. APCRDA
c. TUDA
List-II (Area)
i. Tirupati
ii. Amaravati capital region

Codes:

accepted.sec: Urban development authorities → area (VMRDA, APCRDA, TUDA)

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements about urban development authorities in Andhra Pradesh is correct?
1. Andhra Pradesh has 21 urban development authorities.
2. VMRDA is implementing the Green Triangle eco-tourism project.
3. VMRDA is associated with master-plan roads.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Andhra Pradesh has 21 urban development authorities, and VMRDA is associated with the Green Triangle project and master-plan roads.
accepted.tq: Combine a numerical fact with two authority-function statements without importing unspecified area figures.
accepted.sec: Urban development authorities → area (VMRDA, APCRDA, TUDA)

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT identified as a major migration stream from drought-prone Rayalaseema?
o: Migration exclusively to Visakhapatnam for work in the fishing sector
Distress migration to Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Chennai
Migration from districts such as Anantapur, Kadapa and Chittoor
Migration to Gulf countries as domestic and unskilled workers
accepted.x: The material identifies Gulf migration and distress migration to Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Chennai from drought-prone Rayalaseema. Exclusive migration to Visakhapatnam for fishing is not identified.
accepted.tq: Find the option containing an unsupported destination-sector combination rather than a stated migration pattern.
accepted.sec: Migration from AP - Gulf migration districts, seasonal migration from Rayalaseema/Uttarandhra

accepted.s: The districts specifically identified as drought-prone Rayalaseema districts associated with Gulf migration are:
accepted.x: Anantapur, Kadapa and Chittoor are identified as drought-prone Rayalaseema districts from which many migrate to Gulf countries as domestic and unskilled workers.
accepted.tq: Use the district-list recall pattern and avoid substituting neighbouring AP districts.
accepted.sec: Migration from AP - Gulf migration districts, seasonal migration from Rayalaseema/Uttarandhra

accepted.s: Distress migration from Rayalaseema and north coastal Andhra Pradesh is primarily directed towards:
accepted.x: The principal destinations identified for distress migration are Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Chennai.
accepted.tq: Test the destination cluster directly and distinguish it from AP urban centres mentioned in other contexts.
accepted.sec: Migration from AP - Gulf migration districts, seasonal migration from Rayalaseema/Uttarandhra

accepted.s: The Vijayawada–Guntur–Tenali–Mangalagiri urban area was selected as the capital area mainly because of its:
o: Status as the largest industrial corridor in India
accepted.x: The Vijayawada–Guntur–Tenali–Mangalagiri area was chosen as the capital area because of its central location.
accepted.tq: Link the planning decision to its stated geographic rationale and reject exaggerated size claims.
accepted.sec: Growth corridors and urban clusters (Visakhapatnam-Kakinada, Vijayawada-Guntur-Tenali-Mangalagiri)

accepted.s: Which economic region consists of 10 districts and has a target of USD 750–800 billion by 2047?
accepted.x: The Visakhapatnam Economic Region consists of 10 districts and has a target of USD 750–800 billion by 2047.
accepted.tq: Match the region with both its district count and long-term target.
accepted.sec: Growth corridors and urban clusters (Visakhapatnam-Kakinada, Vijayawada-Guntur-Tenali-Mangalagiri)

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched with the number of districts in the economic region?
accepted.x: The Visakhapatnam Economic Region has 10 districts, the Amaravati Economic Region has 9 districts and the Tirupati Economic Region has 10 districts.
accepted.tq: Use the district counts to detect the swapped figures between similar economic regions.
accepted.sec: Growth corridors and urban clusters (Visakhapatnam-Kakinada, Vijayawada-Guntur-Tenali-Mangalagiri)

accepted.s: The Kopparthy node is associated with which industrial corridor?
accepted.x: Kopparthy in Kadapa is a node of the Visakhapatnam–Chennai Industrial Corridor (VCIC).
accepted.tq: Apply the node-corridor association and distinguish it from Orvakal and Bhogapuram.
accepted.sec: Growth corridors and urban clusters (Visakhapatnam-Kakinada, Vijayawada-Guntur-Tenali-Mangalagiri)

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched?
accepted.x: Kopparthy is in Kadapa and belongs to VCIC. Orvakal in Kurnool is the node associated with the Hyderabad-Bengaluru corridor.
accepted.tq: Find the wrong node-district-corridor combination by checking all three elements.
accepted.sec: Growth corridors and urban clusters (Visakhapatnam-Kakinada, Vijayawada-Guntur-Tenali-Mangalagiri)

accepted.s: Which district recorded the highest urbanisation in the 13-district Census 2011 table?
accepted.x: Visakhapatnam recorded the highest urbanisation in the 13-district table, at 47.45%.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly presents the urbanisation percentages of Visakhapatnam and Krishna districts in the 13-district table?
accepted.x: Visakhapatnam recorded 47.45% urbanisation and Krishna recorded 40.81%.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly presents the urbanisation percentages of Prakasam and Srikakulam in the 13-district table?
accepted.x: Prakasam recorded 19.56% urbanisation, while Srikakulam recorded 16.16%.

accepted.s: The 1991 All-India urbanisation level referred to for comparison was:
accepted.x: The 1991 All-India urbanisation level used for comparison was 22.87%.
accepted.tq: Separate the benchmark percentage from the district-specific percentages.

accepted.s: Which set of districts was below the 1991 All-India urbanisation level of 22.87% in 2011, after including the APSES figure for Prakasam?
o: Srikakulam, Vizianagaram, West Godavari and Prakasam
Guntur, Krishna, Vizianagaram and West Godavari

accepted.s: Under the 28-district map analysed for the 2025–26 period, which district had the highest urbanisation?
accepted.x: Visakhapatnam had the highest urbanisation under the 28-district map, at 89.69%.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the newer 28-district analysis from the older 13-district table.

accepted.s: Which district had the lowest urbanisation under the 28-district map?
accepted.x: Polavaram, a new 2025 district, had the lowest urbanisation at 2.84% under the 28-district map.
accepted.tq: Use the district-map distinction to avoid confusing the new lowest district with the earlier 13-district lowest.
accepted.sec: District-wise urbanisation of AP - most/least urban districts, districts below national averages  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly states the urbanisation and density figures for Visakhapatnam under the 28-district analysis?
o: 47.45% urbanisation and 1,870 persons per sq km
89.69% urbanisation and 870 persons per sq km
2.84% urbanisation and 1,870 persons per sq km
89.69% urbanisation and 1,870 persons per sq km
accepted.x: Visakhapatnam recorded 89.69% urbanisation and the highest density of 1,870 persons per sq km in the 28-district analysis.
accepted.tq: Keep the newer percentage and density figures together and reject altered or borrowed values.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the spatial imbalance in urbanisation between Visakhapatnam and Srikakulam?
o: Visakhapatnam is about 47% urban, whereas Srikakulam is about 16% urban.
Visakhapatnam is about 16% urban, whereas Srikakulam is about 47% urban.
Visakhapatnam is about 89.69% urban, whereas Srikakulam is about 2.84% urban in the 13-district comparison.
accepted.x: The cited spatial imbalance is approximately 47% urban in Visakhapatnam against 16% in Srikakulam, corresponding broadly to the 13-district figures.
accepted.tq: Check the direction of comparison and avoid mixing figures from the separate 28-district analysis.
accepted.sec: District-wise urbanisation of AP - most/least urban districts, districts below national averages  [APPSC, GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which group of cities has been recommended as Tier-2 cities to absorb migration?
accepted.x: Kurnool, Ongole and Rajahmundry have been recommended as Tier-2 cities to help absorb migration.
accepted.tq: Recall the recommended urban-centre group and distinguish it from the capital-area cluster.
